item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 25/Jan/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the winter monsoon, it will still be cold over the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. Meanwhile, the band of clouds covering southern China will thin out slightly. With the monsoon moderating over the weekend, temperatures will rise slightly over the region. A fresh to strong easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of southern China early to midweek next week. An upper-air disturbance will bring unsettled weather to southern China in the latter part of next week, there may be thunderstorms over region.
